# @mod-internal/ui component reference

Every public component, directive and service, grouped by library folder. Search this file for the selector or class you need (for example `mod-dropdown` or `ModToastService`) instead of reading it top to bottom.

`[x]` is an input, `[(x)]` a two-way model (also usable as `[x]` + `(xChange)`), `(x)` an output. Boolean inputs accept the bare attribute (`disabled`) because they use `booleanAttribute`.

## button

### ModButton — `button[mod-button], a[mod-button]`

DGA button. Applied to a native element so focus, keyboard and form behaviour stay native: Icons are projected content: wrap them in `<span class="icon">` (inline SVG) or use `<mod-icon class="icon" name="add-01" />`.

```html
<button mod-button variant="primary" size="medium">Save</button>
<a mod-button variant="secondary-outline" href="/docs">Docs</a>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModButtonVariant` | `'primary'` |  |
| `[size]` | input | `ModButtonSize` | `'large'` |  |
| `[destructive]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Red destructive styling for delete / irreversible actions. |
| `[onColor]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | For use on dark or brand-coloured backgrounds. |
| `[selected]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle-button selected state (also sets aria-pressed). |
| `[loading]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the spinner and hides the label. |
| `[iconOnly]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Square button that contains only an icon. Provide an aria-label. |
| `[fab]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Floating action button. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModButtonVariant = | 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'secondary-solid' | 'secondary-outline' | 'subtle' | 'transparent'
type ModButtonSize = 'large' | 'medium' | 'small'
```

## icon

### ModIcon — `mod-icon`

DGA font icon. Requires the icon stylesheet (`@mod-internal/ui/styles/icons.css`) in the application's global styles. `name` is the icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix.

```html
<mod-icon name="menu-01" />
<mod-icon name="search-01" size="20" label="Search" />
<mod-icon name="star" variant="solid" />
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[name]` | input, required | `string` |  | Icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix, e.g. `menu-01`. |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModIconStyle \| undefined` | `undefined` | Icon style variant. Omit for the default stroke style. |
| `[iconStyle]` | input | `ModIconStyle \| undefined` | `undefined` | Older name of `variant`; used when `variant` is not set. |
| `[size]` | input | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Size in pixels (`size="24"` or `[size]="24"`). Omit to inherit the surrounding font size. |
| `[label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible label. When omitted the icon is hidden from assistive tech. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModIconStyle = 'stroke' | 'solid' | 'bulk' | 'duotone' | 'twotone'
```

## dropdown

### ModDropdown — `mod-dropdown`

DGA dropdown (select). Single select closes on choice and shows a tick; multi select keeps the list open and joins the chosen labels. `value` is the option value (single) or an array of option values (`multiple`).

```html
<mod-dropdown label="Region" placeholder="Select a region" [options]="regions" [(value)]="region" />
<mod-dropdown multiple [options]="services" formControlName="services" />
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(value)]` | model | `T \| T[] \| null` | `null` | Selected value, or array of values when `multiple`. Two-way bindable. |
| `[options]` | input | `ModDropdownOption<T>[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[label]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[placeholder]` | input | `string` | `'Select'` |  |
| `[size]` | input | `ModDropdownSize` | `'lg'` |  |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModDropdownVariant` | `'default'` |  |
| `[multiple]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[error]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Error outline (also implied by `feedback="error"`). |
| `[feedback]` | input | `ModDropdownFeedback \| null` | `null` | Feedback icon inside the trigger. |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[readonly]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name when no visible label is rendered. |
| `[separator]` | input | `string` | `', '` | Separator between labels in multi select. |
| `[compareWith]` | input | `(a: T, b: T) => boolean` | `(a, b) => Object.is(a, b)` | Equality used to match `value` against option values. |
| `(openChange)` | output | `boolean` |  | Emits whenever the list opens or closes. |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModDropdownOption { value: T; label: string; disabled?: boolean; group?: string; }
type ModDropdownSize = 'lg' | 'md'
type ModDropdownVariant = 'default' | 'lighter' | 'darker'
type ModDropdownFeedback = 'error' | 'success' | 'warning'
```

## checkbox

### ModCheckboxGroup — `mod-checkbox-group`

Groups `mod-checkbox` items and owns the list of checked values. Every child checkbox needs a `value`.

```html
<mod-checkbox-group [(value)]="channels" ariaLabel="Notifications">
  <mod-checkbox value="email" label="Email" />
  <mod-checkbox value="sms" label="SMS" />
</mod-checkbox-group>
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).
Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(value)]` | model | `T[]` | `[]` | Values of the checked checkboxes. Two-way bindable. |
| `[orientation]` | input | `ModCheckboxGroupOrientation` | `'vertical'` |  |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[readonly]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[name]` | input | `string` | `''` | `name` applied to every native checkbox in the group. Generated when omitted. |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[ariaLabelledby]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |

### ModCheckbox — `mod-checkbox`

DGA checkbox with optional helper text and alert message. Inside a `mod-checkbox-group` the group owns the state: give each checkbox a `value` and bind the group's `value` array instead.

```html
<mod-checkbox label="Accept terms" [(checked)]="accepted" />
<mod-checkbox [formControl]="ctrl">Projected <b>label</b></mod-checkbox>
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).
Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(checked)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Checked state. Two-way bindable; ignored inside a group (the group owns it). |
| `[(indeterminate)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state. Cleared when the user toggles the checkbox. Two-way bindable. |
| `[label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Label text. Rich labels can be projected as content instead. |
| `[helperText]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[alertText]` | input | `string` | `''` | Error / alert message shown below the checkbox. |
| `[size]` | input | `ModCheckboxSize` | `'medium'` |  |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModCheckboxVariant` | `'primary'` |  |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[readonly]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[required]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[value]` | input | `T \| undefined` | `undefined` | Value contributed to the parent `mod-checkbox-group`. |
| `[name]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModCheckboxGroupOrientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal'
type ModCheckboxSize = 'medium' | 'small' | 'xsmall'
type ModCheckboxVariant = 'primary' | 'neutral'
```

## rating

### ModRating — `mod-rating`

DGA star rating. Click a star's start half for a half value (when `allowHalf`), hover to preview, arrow keys to adjust.

```html
<mod-rating [(value)]="score" />
<mod-rating [value]="2.5" readonly brand size="sm" />
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(value)]` | model | `number` | `0` | Current rating (0…max, in 0.5 steps when `allowHalf`). Two-way bindable. |
| `[max]` | input | `number` | `5` | Number of stars. |
| `[size]` | input | `ModRatingSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `[brand]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Saudi green stars instead of gold. |
| `[readonly]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Display only: no hover, click or keyboard interaction. |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[clearable]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Clicking the current rating again resets it to 0. |
| `[allowHalf]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Allows half-star values by clicking the start half of a star. |
| `[label]` | input | `(value: number, max: number) => string` | `(value, max) => `${value} out of ${max} stars`` | Accessible label of the whole rating. |
| `[starLabel]` | input | `(star: number, max: number) => string` | `(star, max) => `${star} of ${max}`` | Accessible label of each star button. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModRatingSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
type ModRatingFill = 'none' | 'half' | 'full'
```

## date-picker

### ModCalendar — `mod-calendar`

DGA calendar panel (Gregorian): month grid, month arrows and year dropdown. Used by the date pickers as their popup and usable on its own as an always-visible calendar.

```html
<mod-calendar [(value)]="date" />
<mod-calendar mode="range" [(range)]="range" showFooter />
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[mode]` | input | `ModCalendarMode` | `'single'` |  |
| `[(value)]` | model | `Date \| null` | `null` | Selected day in `single` mode (two-way bindable). |
| `[(range)]` | model | `ModDateRange` | `{ start: null, end: null }` | Selected range in `range` mode (two-way bindable). |
| `[min]` | input | `Date \| null` | `null` | Earliest / latest selectable day. |
| `[max]` | input | `Date \| null` | `null` |  |
| `[dateDisabled]` | input | `((date: Date) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Extra predicate that disables individual days. |
| `[inline]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Always visible, in normal flow. The pickers set this to `false` for their popup. |
| `[showFooter]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the Clear / Today footer. |
| `[yearSpan]` | input | `number` | `10` | Years offered before and after the current year in the year dropdown. |
| `[footerAction]` | input | `ModCalendarFooterAction` | `'today'` | Second footer button: `today` selects today, `apply` emits `applied`. |
| `[today]` | input | `Date \| null` | `null` | Day highlighted as today. Defaults to the current day. |
| `[startAt]` | input | `Date \| null` | `null` | Month shown initially when nothing is selected. Defaults to the month of today. |
| `[(yearOpen)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Year dropdown open state (two-way bindable). |
| `[monthNames]` | input | `readonly string[]` | `MOD_MONTH_NAMES` |  |
| `[weekdayLabels]` | input | `readonly string[]` | `MOD_WEEKDAY_LABELS` | Seven labels, Sunday first. |
| `[previousMonthLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Previous month'` |  |
| `[nextMonthLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Next month'` |  |

| `[clearLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Clear'` |  |
| `[todayLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Today'` |  |
| `[applyLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Apply'` |  |
| `(selectionComplete)` | output | `void` |  | A day (single) or a complete range was chosen by the user. |
| `(cleared)` | output | `void` |  | The footer's Clear button was pressed. |
| `(applied)` | output | `void` |  | The footer's Apply button was pressed (`footerAction="apply"`). |

### ModDateField — `mod-date-field`

DGA date field — the read-only input with a calendar icon that triggers a calendar. Presentational: the date pickers compose it with `ModCalendar`, and it can be used on its own next to an inline calendar.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |

## file-upload

### ModFileUpload — `mod-file-upload`

DGA file upload — dashed drop area, browse button and a removable file list. Form control with `File[]` as its value (only files that pass validation). Files that fail the `accept` / `maxSize` checks are listed with an error row, reported through `rejected`, and never become part of the value. The component does not upload anything itself: pass the files that are still in flight through `uploadingFiles` to show the spinner on their rows.

```html
<mod-file-upload multiple accept=".jpg,.png,.pdf" [maxSize]="2 * 1024 * 1024"
                 formats="Max 2MB — .jpg, .png, and .pdf" [(value)]="files" />
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(value)]` | model | `File[]` | `[]` | Accepted files (two-way bindable). |
| `[multiple]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Allow more than one file. In single mode a new file replaces the list. |
| `[accept]` | input | `string` | `''` | Native `accept` list (`.pdf,.png`, `image/*`, `application/pdf`). Also enforced on drop. |
| `[maxSize]` | input | `number` | `0` | Maximum size of one file in bytes. `0` = no limit. |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[uploadingFiles]` | input | `readonly File[]` | `[]` | Files currently being uploaded by the application (spinner instead of the check). |
| `[failedFiles]` | input | `readonly ModFileUploadFailure[]` | `[]` | Files of the value whose upload failed: their rows show the error state with the message. |
| `[dragActive]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the drag-over look of the drop area (it is otherwise set while a file hovers). |
| `[hideDropArea]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the drop area and renders only the files list. |
| `[instructions]` | input | `string` |  | Main instruction text. Default depends on the mode: "Drag and drop your files here" (multiple) / "Drag and drop your file here" (single). |
| `[formats]` | input | `string` | `''` | Hint under the instructions, e.g. "Max 2MB — .jpg, .png, and .pdf". |
| `[browseLabel]` | input | `string` |  | Browse button label. Default: "Browse files" (multiple) / "Browse file" (single). |
| `[replaceLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Replace file'` | Single mode only: browse button label once a file is selected, since the next pick replaces it. Default: "Replace file". |
| `[removeLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Remove file'` |  |
| `[uploadingLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Uploading'` |  |
| `[sizeErrorMessage]` | input | `string` | `'File exceeds the size limit.'` |  |
| `[typeErrorMessage]` | input | `string` | `'File type is not supported.'` |  |
| `[filesListLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Selected files'` | Accessible name of the file list. |
| `(rejected)` | output | `ModFileUploadRejection[]` |  | Files that failed validation in the last pick / drop. |
| `(fileRemoved)` | output | `File` |  | A file row was removed by the user. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModFileUploadRejectionReason = 'size' | 'type'
interface ModFileUploadRejection { file: File; reason: ModFileUploadRejectionReason; message: string; }
interface ModFileUploadFailure { file: File; message: string; }
```

## digital-stamp

### ModNavHeader — `mod-nav-header`

DGA navigation header: logo, menu items (with optional sub-menu dropdowns), action buttons and the responsive hamburger panel. The component does not depend on the router: listen to `itemSelect`, `subItemSelect` and `actionSelect` and navigate yourself, or give items a plain `href`.

```html
<mod-nav-header [items]="items" [actions]="actions" [(activeId)]="current"
                (itemSelect)="go($event)">
  <img modNavHeaderLogo src="logo.svg" alt="My platform" />
  <a mod-header-action variant="primary" href="/ar"><span>عربي</span></a>
</mod-nav-header>
```

Content slots: `[modNavHeaderLogo]`, `[mod-header-action], [modNavHeaderAction]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input | `ModNavHeaderItem[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[actions]` | input | `ModNavHeaderAction[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[(activeId)]` | model | `string \| null` | `null` | Key (`id`, or `label` when no id) of the selected menu item. |
| `[(mobileOpen)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Open state of the mobile (hamburger) panel. |
| `[responsive]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Collapse to the hamburger layout at the source breakpoints (960px / 600px). |
| `[layout]` | input | `ModNavHeaderLayout` | `'auto'` | Forces the desktop, tablet or mobile layout; `auto` follows the viewport. |
| `[fullWidth]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Span edge to edge. When false the header is centered in a 1280px container. |
| `[hideLogo]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the logo slot (and the built-in placeholder). |
| `[expandedSubmenuId]` | input | `string \| null` | `null` | Key of a menu item whose sub-menu is rendered permanently open as a full-width panel under the header (mega-menu) instead of a dropdown. |
| `[divider]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Bottom border under the header. |
| `[submenuVariant]` | input | `ModNavHeaderSubmenuVariant` | `'default'` |  |
| `[submenuIconStyle]` | input | `ModNavHeaderSubmenuIconStyle` | `'plain'` |  |
| `[logoText]` | input | `string` | `'Platform Logo'` | Text of the built-in logo placeholder (shown when no logo is projected). |
| `[logoSize]` | input | `ModNavHeaderLogoSize` | `'medium'` |  |
| `[logoPosition]` | input | `ModNavHeaderLogoPosition` | `'side'` |  |
| `[menuLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Main menu'` |  |
| `[openMenuLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Open menu'` |  |
| `[closeMenuLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Close menu'` |  |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModNavHeaderItem` |  | A menu item without a sub-menu was activated. |
| `(subItemSelect)` | output | `{ item: ModNavHeaderItem; subItem: ModNavHeaderSubItem }` |  | A link inside a sub-menu was activated. |
| `(actionSelect)` | output | `ModNavHeaderAction` |  | An action from the `actions` input was activated. |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModNavHeaderSubItem { id?: string; label: string; helper?: string; href?: string; icon?: string; }
interface ModNavHeaderGroup { label?: string; items: ModNavHeaderSubItem[]; }
interface ModNavHeaderItem { id?: string; label: string; href?: string; icon?: string; active?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; state?: ModNavHeaderVisualState; arrow?: boolean; children?: ModNavHeaderSubItem[]; groups?: ModNavHeaderGroup[]; }
type ModNavHeaderVisualState = 'default' | 'hovered' | 'pressed' | 'focused'
type ModHeaderActionVariant = 'outline' | 'primary'
type ModHeaderActionIconPosition = 'side' | 'top'
interface ModNavHeaderAction { id?: string; label: string; href?: string; icon?: string; variant?: ModHeaderActionVariant; iconOnly?: boolean; iconPosition?: ModHeaderActionIconPosition; selected?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; state?: ModNavHeaderVisualState; }
type ModNavHeaderLogoSize = 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
type ModNavHeaderLogoPosition = 'side' | 'top'
type ModNavHeaderSubmenuVariant = 'default' | 'brand'
type ModNavHeaderSubmenuIconStyle = 'plain' | 'boxed'
type ModNavHeaderLayout = 'auto' | 'desktop' | 'tablet' | 'mobile'
```

## nav-drawer

### ModNavDrawer — `mod-nav-drawer`

DGA navigation drawer: 256px vertical navigation with an optional logo header, two item levels, badges, dividers and arrow-key navigation. Project an element marked `modNavDrawerLogo` to replace the logo placeholder. The drawer fills the height of its container.

```html
<mod-nav-drawer [items]="items" background="gray" [(activeId)]="current"
                (itemSelect)="go($event)" />
```

Content slots: `[modNavDrawerLogo]`, `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input | `ModNavDrawerItem[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[(activeId)]` | model | `string \| null` | `null` | Key (`id`, or `label` when no id) of the selected item. |
| `[background]` | input | `ModNavDrawerBackground` | `'white'` |  |
| `[header]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Show the 72px logo header. |
| `[headerDivider]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Line under the header. |
| `[logoText]` | input | `string` | `'Platform Logo'` | Text of the built-in logo placeholder (shown when no logo is projected). |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Main navigation'` |  |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModNavDrawerItem` |  | A link (level 1 or 2) was activated. |
| `(expandedChange)` | output | `{ item: ModNavDrawerItem; expanded: boolean }` |  | A parent item was expanded or collapsed. |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModNavDrawerItem { id?: string; label?: string; href?: string; icon?: string; badge?: string; external?: boolean; active?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; divider?: boolean; children?: ModNavDrawerItem[]; expanded?: boolean; }
type ModNavDrawerBackground = 'white' | 'gray' | 'green'
```

## sidebar

### ModSidebar — `mod-sidebar`

DGA docs-shell sidebar: sticky 220px column of `.sidebar-link`s. The source positions it for a 72px fixed header (`top: 72px`, `height: calc(100vh - 72px)`), and hides it below 768px.

```html
<mod-sidebar [items]="items" [(activeId)]="current" (itemSelect)="go($event)" />
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input | `ModSidebarItem[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[(activeId)]` | model | `string \| null` | `null` | Key (`id`, or `label` when no id) of the active link. |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Sidebar'` |  |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModSidebarItem` |  |  |

### ModSidebarNav — `mod-sidebar-nav`

DGA sidebar navigation: bordered 200px vertical nav with optional group titles and a collapsed (icon-only, 64px) mode.

```html
<mod-sidebar-nav [items]="items" [(activeId)]="current" [collapsed]="mini" />
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input | `ModSidebarItem[]` | `[]` | Ungrouped items, rendered first. |
| `[groups]` | input | `ModSidebarGroup[]` | `[]` | Titled groups, rendered after `items`. |
| `[(activeId)]` | model | `string \| null` | `null` | Key (`id`, or `label` when no id) of the active item. |
| `[collapsed]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Icon-only 64px mode. |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Sidebar'` |  |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModSidebarItem` |  |  |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModSidebarItem { id?: string; label: string; href?: string; icon?: string; badge?: string; active?: boolean; }
interface ModSidebarGroup { title?: string; items: ModSidebarItem[]; }
```

## slideout-menu

### ModSlideoutFooter — `[modSlideoutFooter]`

Footer row of a slideout (equal-width action buttons):

```html
<div modSlideoutFooter>
  <button mod-button variant="secondary-outline">Cancel</button>
  <button mod-button>Confirm</button>
</div>
```

### ModSlideoutMenu — `mod-slideout-menu`

DGA slideout menu: a 346px side panel that slides over the page with a dimmed backdrop, or sits inline in the page flow. The body is projected content; alternatively pass `groups` to render a menu (requires the Menu component styles). While open as an overlay the page scroll is locked, focus moves into the panel and is kept there, and Escape or a backdrop click closes it and restores focus.

```html
<mod-slideout-menu [(open)]="open" heading="Filters" description="Refine the list"
                   icon="filter" side="right">
  …body content…
  <div modSlideoutFooter>…buttons…</div>
</mod-slideout-menu>
```

Content slots: `(default)`, `[modSlideoutFooter]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(open)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Open state of the overlay panel. Ignored when `inline`. |
| `[side]` | input | `ModSlideoutSide` | `'left'` | Edge the panel is anchored to (mirrored automatically under `dir="rtl"`). |
| `[gray]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Gray background variant. |
| `[inline]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Render in normal flow (no backdrop, no fixed positioning). |
| `[heading]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[description]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Featured icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. |
| `[showClose]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[closeLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Close'` |  |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name when there is no `heading`. |
| `[closeOnBackdrop]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[closeOnEscape]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[groups]` | input | `ModSlideoutMenuGroup[]` | `[]` | Optional menu rendered at the top of the body. |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModSlideoutMenuItem` |  | A row from `groups` was activated. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModSlideoutSide = 'left' | 'right'
interface ModSlideoutMenuItem { id?: string; label: string; icon?: string; selected?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; }
interface ModSlideoutMenuGroup { label?: string; items: ModSlideoutMenuItem[]; }
```

## footer

### ModFooter — `mod-footer`

DGA footer: link groups, social media and accessibility icon rows, legal links, copyright caption and logos. Light (gray) or dark green. Slots: default content is appended to the link-group row (use `<div class="footer__group">`), elements marked `modFooterLogo` are appended to the logos row.

```html
<mod-footer [groups]="groups" [socialLinks]="social" [legalLinks]="legal"
            legalCaption="All rights reserved © 2026" (linkSelect)="go($event)" />
```

Content slots: `(default)`, `[modFooterLogo]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[dark]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Dark green background variant. |
| `[mobilePreview]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Force the <600px layout regardless of viewport width. |
| `[groups]` | input | `ModFooterGroup[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[socialTitle]` | input | `string` | `'Social Media'` |  |
| `[socialLinks]` | input | `ModFooterIconAction[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[accessibilityTitle]` | input | `string` | `'Accessibility Tools'` |  |
| `[accessibilityTools]` | input | `ModFooterIconAction[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[legalLinks]` | input | `ModFooterLink[]` | `[]` | Underlined links row above the caption. |
| `[legalCaption]` | input | `string` | `''` | Copyright line. |
| `[extraLinks]` | input | `ModFooterLink[]` | `[]` | Links under the caption (terms, privacy…). |
| `[logos]` | input | `ModFooterLogo[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessible name of the footer landmark. |
| `(linkSelect)` | output | `ModFooterLink` |  | Any text link (group, legal or extra) was activated. |
| `(actionSelect)` | output | `ModFooterIconAction` |  | A social media or accessibility icon button was activated. |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModFooterLink { id?: string; label: string; href?: string; external?: boolean; }
interface ModFooterGroup { label: string; links: ModFooterLink[]; }
interface ModFooterIconAction { id?: string; label: string; icon: string; href?: string; }
interface ModFooterLogo { src?: string; alt?: string; height?: number; text?: string; }
```

## menus

### ModMenuAnchor — `mod-menu-anchor`

Wrapper that anchors a dropdown `<mod-menu>` to its trigger. Closes on outside click and on Escape (focus returns to the trigger).

```html
<mod-menu-anchor [(open)]="open">
  <button mod-button modMenuTrigger>Options</button>
  <mod-menu>
    <mod-menu-item icon="edit-01" (activated)="edit()">Edit</mod-menu-item>
  </mod-menu>
</mod-menu-anchor>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(open)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the anchored menu is open. |

### ModMenuTrigger — `[modMenuTrigger]`

Turns a button inside `<mod-menu-anchor>` into the menu trigger: click toggles, ArrowDown opens, and aria-haspopup / aria-expanded are kept in sync.

### ModMenu — `mod-menu`

DGA menu: a list of actions/options. Use it inline, or inside `<mod-menu-anchor>` to get dropdown behaviour. Keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move between enabled items (wrapping), Home/End jump to the first/last item, Enter/Space activate.

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[id]` | input | `string` | ``mod-menu-${nextMenuId++}`` |  |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[rtl]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the RTL layout (`menu--rtl`) regardless of the page direction. |
| `[closeOnSelect]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | When anchored: close the menu after an item is activated. |

### ModMenuGroup — `mod-menu-group`

Group of menu items with an optional uppercase label. Adjacent groups are separated by a divider. With `selectable`, the group behaves as a single-select list bound to `value` (items need a `value`).

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[label]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[selectable]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Single-select behaviour: activating an item sets `value` to the item's value. |
| `[(value)]` | model | `unknown` | `undefined` | Value of the selected item when `selectable`. |

### ModMenuDivider — `mod-menu-divider`

Standalone 1px divider between items.

### ModMenuTrail — `[modMenuTrail]`

Marks projected content as the trailing element of a menu item (e.g. a tag): `<span modMenuTrail><span class="tag tag--sm">New</span></span>`.

### ModMenuTrailIcon — `[modMenuTrailIcon]`

Marks a projected inline SVG wrapper as the trailing icon of a menu item: `<span modMenuTrailIcon><svg …/></span>`.

### ModMenuItem — `mod-menu-item, a[mod-menu-item], button[mod-menu-item]`

Menu item. The projected content is the label.

```html
<mod-menu-item icon="file-01" trailText="+99">Inbox</mod-menu-item>
<a mod-menu-item href="/profile">Profile</a>
```

Content slots: `(default)`, `[modMenuTrail], [modMenuTrailIcon], mod-menu-switch`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Leading font icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. |
| `[trailText]` | input | `string` | `''` | Trailing short text (count, shortcut…). |
| `[trailIcon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Trailing font icon name (e.g. a submenu arrow). Replaces the selected checkmark. |
| `[selected]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[checkmark]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Show a trailing check icon while selected. |
| `[value]` | input | `unknown` | `undefined` | Value used by a `selectable` `<mod-menu-group>`. |
| `(activated)` | output | `void` |  | Emitted on click / Enter / Space when the item is enabled. |

### ModMenuSwitch — `mod-menu-switch`

Trailing toggle for a menu item.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(checked)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |

## breadcrumbs

### ModBreadcrumbs — `mod-breadcrumbs`

DGA breadcrumb trail. The last item is rendered as the current page. With `collapse`, a trail longer than three items keeps the root, the last middle link and the current page, and moves the rest into an overflow (…) dropdown. The component does not depend on a router: handle `itemSelected` (and `event.preventDefault()`) to navigate in a single-page app.

```html
<mod-breadcrumbs [items]="trail" collapse (itemSelected)="go($event)" />
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input, required | `ModBreadcrumbItem[]` |  |  |
| `[collapse]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Collapse the middle of a long trail (more than three items) into an overflow dropdown. |
| `[rtl]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the RTL layout (`breadcrumb--rtl`) regardless of the page direction. |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `'Breadcrumb'` |  |
| `[moreLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Show more links'` | Accessible label of the overflow (…) button. |
| `(itemSelected)` | output | `ModBreadcrumbSelectEvent` |  |  |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModBreadcrumbItem { label: string; href?: string; id?: string; }
interface ModBreadcrumbSelectEvent { item: ModBreadcrumbItem; index: number; event: Event; }
```

## tabs

### ModTab — `mod-tab`

A single tab inside `<mod-tabs>`. The projected content is the panel.

```html
<mod-tab label="Overview" icon="home-01">…panel…</mod-tab>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[label]` | input, required | `string` |  |  |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Font icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[value]` | input | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Optional identifier reported in `selectionChange` and usable with `selectByValue()`. |

### ModTabs — `mod-tabs`

DGA horizontal tabs. Keyboard (as in the source): ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move and activate the previous/next enabled tab (mirrored inside `[dir="rtl"]`), Home/End jump to the first/last tab. Only the selected tab is in the tab order.

```html
<mod-tabs [(selectedIndex)]="index" size="md">
  <mod-tab label="First">…</mod-tab>
  <mod-tab label="Second" disabled>…</mod-tab>
</mod-tabs>
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(selectedIndex)]` | model | `number` | `0` | Index of the selected tab. |
| `[size]` | input | `ModTabsSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `[divider]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Full-width line under the tab list. |
| `[flush]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Flush variant: tabs are pulled out by the tab padding so the first label aligns with the container edge. |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `(selectionChange)` | output | `ModTabChangeEvent` |  | Emitted when the user selects another tab (click or keyboard). |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModTabsSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
interface ModTabChangeEvent { index: number; value: string | undefined; }
```

## links

### ModLink — `a[mod-link]`

DGA link. Applied to a native anchor so navigation, focus and keyboard behaviour stay native: For a leading/trailing icon set `withIcon` and project an element with the `link__icon` class (inline SVG) or a `<mod-icon>`.

```html
<a mod-link href="/docs">Docs</a>
<a mod-link variant="danger" underline="always" href="/delete">Delete</a>
<a mod-link external href="https://example.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Site</a>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModLinkVariant` | `'primary'` |  |
| `[underline]` | input | `ModLinkUnderline` | `'none'` |  |
| `[size]` | input | `ModLinkSize` | `'md'` | `md` inherits the surrounding font size. |
| `[external]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Appends the external-link glyph. |
| `[withIcon]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Inline-flex layout with a gap, for links that contain an icon. |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModLinkVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'muted' | 'danger'
type ModLinkUnderline = 'none' | 'always' | 'hover'
type ModLinkSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
```

## accordion

### ModAccordion — `mod-accordion`

DGA accordion container. `size`, `iconPosition` and `flush` apply to every item unless the item overrides them.

```html
<mod-accordion size="md" [multiple]="false">
  <mod-accordion-item heading="Question?">Answer.</mod-accordion-item>
</mod-accordion>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[size]` | input | `ModAccordionSize` | `'lg'` |  |
| `[iconPosition]` | input | `ModAccordionIconPosition` | `'trailing'` |  |
| `[flush]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Inset ("cut") separators. |
| `[multiple]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Allow several items to be open at once (source behaviour). Set to false for single-expand. |

### ModAccordionItem — `mod-accordion-item`

One collapsible section. The projected content is the body; the header text comes from `heading`, or project rich content with the `modAccordionHeading` attribute.

Content slots: `[modAccordionHeading]`, `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |

| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[size]` | input | `ModAccordionSize \| undefined` | `undefined` | Overrides the accordion's `size`. |
| `[iconPosition]` | input | `ModAccordionIconPosition \| undefined` | `undefined` | Overrides the accordion's `iconPosition`. |

## modal

### ModModalActions — `mod-modal-actions`

Actions row of a `<mod-modal>`. Buttons must be direct children: With three or more buttons the first one is pushed to the leading edge.

```html
<mod-modal-actions>
  <button mod-button variant="secondary-outline" modModalClose>Cancel</button>
  <button mod-button (click)="save()">Save</button>
</mod-modal-actions>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[stack]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Vertical, full-width buttons (put the primary button first). |
| `[fill]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Every button stretches to share the row equally. |
| `[center]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Groups the buttons in the centre. |
| `[keepInline]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the inline layout below 480px instead of stacking. |

### ModModal — `mod-modal`

DGA modal dialog. Slots: default content goes in the body, `[modModalHeader]` adds content to the header under the title, `<mod-modal-actions>` is the footer.

```html
<mod-modal [(open)]="isOpen" heading="Delete file?" description="This cannot be undone." icon="information-circle">
  <p>Any extra body content</p>
  <mod-modal-actions>
    <button mod-button variant="secondary-outline" modModalClose>Cancel</button>
    <button mod-button destructive (click)="remove()">Delete</button>
  </mod-modal-actions>
</mod-modal>
```

Content slots: `[modModalHeader]`, `(default)`, `mod-modal-actions`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(open)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the modal is open. Two-way bindable. |
| `[inline]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the dialog in the page flow, always visible, without backdrop, focus trap or scroll lock (for previews and documentation). `open` is ignored. |
| `[heading]` | input | `string` | `''` | Title text; also labels the dialog. |
| `[description]` | input | `string` | `''` | Description paragraph at the top of the body. |
| `[size]` | input | `ModModalSize` | `'default'` | `mobile` narrows the dialog to 320px. |
| `[align]` | input | `ModModalAlign` | `'start'` | `center` centres the featured icon and title. |
| `[position]` | input | `ModModalPosition` | `'center'` | Vertical position of the dialog in the viewport. |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Featured icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. Empty hides it. |
| `[iconColor]` | input | `ModModalIconColor` | `'neutral'` |  |
| `[iconVariant]` | input | `ModModalIconVariant` | `'light'` | Applies only when `iconColor` is not `neutral`. |
| `[closable]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the close (X) button. |
| `[closeOnEscape]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[closeOnBackdrop]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[closeLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Close'` | Accessible label of the close button. |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name when there is no `heading`. |
| `[ariaLabelledby]` | input | `string` | `''` | Id of an external element that labels the dialog (overrides `heading`). |
| `(opened)` | output | `void` |  | Emits after the modal opens. |
| `(closed)` | output | `ModModalCloseReason` |  | Emits after the modal closes, with what caused it. |

### ModModalClose — `[modModalClose]`

Closes the enclosing `<mod-modal>` when the host element is clicked:

```html
<button mod-button variant="secondary-outline" modModalClose>Cancel</button>
```

Exported types:

```ts
type ModModalSize = 'default' | 'mobile'
type ModModalAlign = 'start' | 'center'
type ModModalPosition = 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
type ModModalIconColor = 'neutral' | 'brand' | 'gray' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'
type ModModalIconVariant = 'light' | 'dark' | 'outlined'
type ModModalCloseReason = 'escape' | 'backdrop' | 'close-button' | 'action' | 'api'
```

## tooltip

### ModTooltip — `mod-tooltip`

Static DGA tooltip element. Place it inside a `.tooltip-wrapper` next to its trigger; the source CSS shows it on wrapper hover, or set `visible`. For most cases prefer the `[modTooltip]` directive, which also handles keyboard focus, Escape and `aria-describedby`.

```html
<span class="tooltip-wrapper">
  <button mod-button aria-describedby="tip">Save</button>
  <mod-tooltip id="tip" position="bottom">Saves the draft</mod-tooltip>
</span>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[position]` | input | `ModTooltipPosition` | `'top'` |  |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModTooltipVariant` | `'dark'` |  |
| `[multiline]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Wraps long text (max-width 200px, centred). |
| `[visible]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the tooltip visible regardless of hover. |

### ModTooltipDirective — `[modTooltip]`

Adds a DGA tooltip to any element. Shown on hover and keyboard focus, hidden on leave, blur and Escape, and linked with `aria-describedby`. The tooltip markup (`.tooltip-wrapper` > `.tooltip`) is rendered in `<body>` inside a fixed wrapper that mirrors the trigger's rectangle, so the source positioning CSS applies and the tooltip is never clipped by an `overflow: hidden` ancestor.

```html
<button mod-button modTooltip="Saves the draft" tooltipPosition="bottom">Save</button>
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[modTooltip]` | input | `string` | `''` | Tooltip text. An empty string disables the tooltip. |
| `[tooltipPosition]` | input | `ModTooltipPosition` | `'top'` |  |
| `[tooltipVariant]` | input | `ModTooltipVariant` | `'dark'` |  |
| `[tooltipMultiline]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[tooltipDisabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[tooltipShowDelay]` | input | `number` | `0` | Delay before showing, in milliseconds. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModTooltipPosition = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'
type ModTooltipVariant = 'dark' | 'light'
```

## notification

### ModNotificationActions — `[modNotificationActions]`

Marks the actions of a `<mod-notification>`: Use it on an `<ng-container>` (or a single element) so the projected controls become direct children of `.notification__actions`.

```html
<ng-container modNotificationActions>
  <a class="notification__link" href="/more">Learn more</a>
  <button mod-button variant="neutral" size="medium">Action</button>
</ng-container>
```

### ModNotification — `mod-notification`

DGA notification banner. The message is the projected content.

```html
<mod-notification variant="warning" leadText="Important:" dismissible (dismissed)="onClose()">
  Scheduled maintenance tonight.
</mod-notification>
```

Content slots: `(default)`, `[modNotificationActions]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModNotificationVariant` | `'info'` |  |
| `[leadText]` | input | `string` | `''` | Bold lead-in text, e.g. "Important:". |
| `[showIcon]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[dismissible]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the close button. |
| `[closeLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Accessible label of the close button. |
| `[(visible)]` | model | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the notification is shown. Set back to `true` to show it again. |
| `(dismissed)` | output | `void` |  | Emits after the user dismisses the notification. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModNotificationVariant = 'critical' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'info' | 'neutral'
```

## notification-toast

### ModToastActions — `[modToastActions]`

Marks the action buttons of a `<mod-toast>`. Put it on an `<ng-container>` wrapping the buttons so they become direct children of the actions row:

```html
<ng-container modToastActions>
  <button mod-button variant="subtle" size="medium">Undo</button>
</ng-container>
```

### ModToast — `mod-toast`

A single DGA notification toast. Use it directly for a static / inline toast, or use `ModToastService` + `<mod-toast-container>` for transient toasts.

```html
<mod-toast variant="success" heading="Saved" message="Your changes were saved." (dismissed)="hide()" />
```

Content slots: `[modToastActions]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModToastVariant` | `'neutral'` |  |
| `[heading]` | input, required | `string` |  | Toast title. |
| `[message]` | input | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the title. |
| `[mobile]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Narrow mobile layout (343px, stacked actions, accent line on top). |
| `[dismissible]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the close button. |
| `[closeLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Accessible label of the close button. |
| `[announce]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Announce the toast itself (`role="alert"` for critical, `role="status"` otherwise). `<mod-toast-container>` turns this off because the container is the live region. |
| `(dismissed)` | output | `void` |  | Emits when the close button is pressed. The toast does not hide itself: remove it from the template (the toast service does this for you). |

### ModToastContainer — `mod-toast-container`

Host for the toasts shown through `ModToastService`. Place it once, near the root of the application: It is a polite live region. Auto-dismiss timers pause while a toast is hovered or contains focus.

```html
<mod-toast-container position="top-end" />
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[position]` | input | `ModToastPosition` | `'top-end'` | Screen corner / edge where toasts stack. `start`/`end` follow the text direction. |
| `[mobile]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Render toasts in the narrow mobile layout. |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Notifications'` | Accessible name of the region. |

### ModToastService — `ModToastService` (service, `providedIn: 'root'`)

Shows transient toasts in the `<mod-toast-container>` placed once in the application shell.

```ts
const ref = toast.show({ title: 'Saved', variant: 'success' });
ref.dismiss();
```

| Member | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `toasts` | Toasts currently shown, oldest first. |
| `show(options: ModToastOptions): ModToastRef` |  |
| `dismiss(id: string): void` | Removes one toast. |
| `clear(): void` | Removes every toast. |
| `pause(id: string): void` | Pauses the auto-dismiss timer (the container calls this on hover / focus). |
| `resume(id: string): void` | Restarts a paused auto-dismiss timer with the time that was left. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModToastVariant = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'critical' | 'warning' | 'success'
type ModToastPosition = | 'top-start' | 'top-center' | 'top-end' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-end'
interface ModToastAction { label: string; handler?: () => void; dismissOnClick?: boolean; }
interface ModToastOptions { title: string; message?: string; variant?: ModToastVariant; duration?: number; dismissible?: boolean; closeLabel?: string; actions?: readonly ModToastAction[]; }
interface ModToastItem { readonly id: string; readonly title: string; readonly message: string; readonly variant: ModToastVariant; readonly duration: number; readonly dismissible: boolean; readonly closeLabel: string; readonly actions: readonly ModToastAction[]; }
interface ModToastRef { readonly id: string; dismiss(): void; }
```

## progress-indicator

### ModProgressIndicator — `mod-progress-indicator`

DGA progress indicator (stepper). `current` is the 1-based number of the current step; steps before it are completed, steps after it are upcoming. A value above the number of steps marks every step completed.

```html
<mod-progress-indicator [steps]="steps" [(current)]="step" interactive />
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[steps]` | input, required | `readonly ModProgressStep[]` |  |  |
| `[(current)]` | model | `number` | `1` | 1-based number of the current step. |
| `[orientation]` | input | `ModProgressIndicatorOrientation` | `'horizontal'` |  |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModProgressIndicatorVariant` | `'number'` | `number` shows the step number / check mark, `dot` shows small dots. |
| `[showName]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[showDescription]` | input | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `[interactive]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the circles focusable buttons that set `current` when activated. |
| `[focused]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the focus ring on every step circle (static previews of the focused state). |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Progress'` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `[stepLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Step'` | Text used in each circle's accessible name. |
| `[completedLabel]` | input | `string` | `'completed'` |  |
| `[currentLabel]` | input | `string` | `'current'` |  |
| `[upcomingLabel]` | input | `string` | `'upcoming'` |  |
| `(stepSelected)` | output | `number` |  | Emits the 1-based step number when a step is activated (interactive only). |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModProgressStep { name: string; description?: string; }
type ModProgressStepStatus = 'completed' | 'current' | 'upcoming'
type ModProgressIndicatorOrientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
type ModProgressIndicatorVariant = 'number' | 'dot'
```

DGA skeleton placeholder. Decorative by default (`aria-hidden`). Put `aria-busy="true"` and a visually-hidden loading message on the region that is loading. The composite layout helpers from the source (`.skeleton-pattern*`) are plain CSS classes shipped with this component.

<mod-skeleton shape="circle" width="64" height="64" />

| `[short]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Short rectangle (button-sized). Requires a `size`. |
| `[rounded]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Larger corner radius for squares. |
| `[animated]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Pulse animation. |
| `[width]` | input | `string \| number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Width override. A number (or numeric string) is treated as pixels. |
| `[height]` | input | `string \| number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Height override. A number (or numeric string) is treated as pixels. |

Exported types:

```ts

type ModSkeletonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
type ModSkeletonGradient = 'type1' | 'type2'
```

| `[alt]` | input | `string` | `''` | Alternative text for the image. |
| `[initials]` | input | `string` | `''` | Initials (rendered uppercase) when there is no image. |

| `[bordered]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Subtle inner ring. |

## auth-layout

### ModAuthLogo — `[modAuthLogo]`

Marks the logo of a `<mod-auth-layout>` (top start corner).

### ModAuthPanel — `[modAuthPanel]`

Marks extra content shown under the text of the brand panel (split variant).

### ModAuthLayout — `mod-auth-layout`

Page layout for sign-in, sign-up, verification and password pages. `variant="split"` (default) shows the form next to a brand panel: a photo under a dark-green tint, an optional ring of process icons, a title and one line of text. `variant="centered"` shows only the form, centred on the page. The panel moves above the form on narrow containers. The layout fills the viewport height; set the `--mod-auth-min-height` CSS variable on the element to embed it in a smaller area.

```html
<mod-auth-layout
  panelImage="assets/facility.jpg"
  panelTitle="Referral system"
  panelText="One path between hospitals."
  [panelIcons]="['medical-file', 'hospital-bed-01', 'patient']"
>
  <img modAuthLogo src="assets/logo.png" alt="Organization name" />
  <button modAuthActions mod-button variant="secondary-outline" size="medium">عربي</button>
  <mod-auth-header heading="Sign in" description="Enter your user name and password" underline />
  …form…
  <span modAuthFooter>© Organization name 2026</span>
</mod-auth-layout>
```

Content slots: `[modAuthPanel]`, `[modAuthLogo]`, `[modAuthActions]`, `(default)`, `[modAuthFooter]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[variant]` | input | `ModAuthLayoutVariant` | `'split'` |  |
| `[panelStart]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Puts the brand panel on the start side instead of the end side. |
| `[card]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the form area as a bordered card (useful with `variant="centered"`). |
| `[muted]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Flat gray page background behind the form area instead of the white gradient (pairs with `card`). |
| `[panelImage]` | input | `string` | `''` | Brand panel photo. Decorative: it is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `[panelImagePosition]` | input | `string` | `'50% 40%'` | CSS `object-position` of the photo. |
| `[panelTitle]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[panelText]` | input | `string` | `''` |  |
| `[panelIcons]` | input | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Up to three icon names (without the `dga-icon-` prefix) placed on the ring. Empty hides the ring. |

## otp-input

### ModOtpInput — `mod-otp-input`

One-time code input: one box per character. Typing moves to the next box, Backspace to the previous one, the arrow keys move between boxes, and pasting a code fills all boxes. The value is the typed characters as one string (shorter than `length` until complete). The boxes always run left to right, also on right-to-left pages.

```html
<mod-otp-input [(value)]="code" (completed)="verify($event)" />
<mod-otp-input [length]="4" formControlName="code" />
```

Works with `ngModel`, `formControl` and `formControlName` (ControlValueAccessor).

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(value)]` | model | `string` | `''` | The code typed so far. Two-way bindable; also driven by Angular forms. |
| `[length]` | input | `number` | `6` | Number of boxes. |
| `[mode]` | input | `ModOtpInputMode` | `'numeric'` | `numeric` accepts digits only; `alphanumeric` also accepts letters. |
| `[size]` | input | `ModOtpInputSize` | `'medium'` |  |
| `[groupSize]` | input | `number` | `0` | Shows a short dash after every N boxes (e.g. 3 for "123-456"). 0 = none. |
| `[error]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[disabled]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[ariaLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Verification code'` | Accessible name of the whole group. |
| `[digitLabel]` | input | `(position: number, length: number) => string` | `(position, length) => `Digit ${position} of ${length}`` | Accessible name of each box. |
| `(completed)` | output | `string` |  | Emits the full code when the last empty box is filled. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModOtpInputSize = 'medium' | 'large'
type ModOtpInputMode = 'numeric' | 'alphanumeric'
```

## app-shell

### ModAppShellLogo — `[modAppShellLogo]`

Marks the logo shown at the top of the side bar of a `<mod-app-shell>`.

### ModAppShellLogoMark — `[modAppShellLogoMark]`

Marks the compact logo (emblem) shown instead of the logo while the side bar is collapsed. Optional.

### ModAppShellFooter — `[modAppShellFooter]`

Marks content pinned to the bottom of the side bar (current user, version, help link).

### ModAppShellTitle — `[modAppShellTitle]`

Marks the start content of the top bar: system name, page title or breadcrumbs.

### ModAppShellSearch — `[modAppShellSearch]`

Marks the search field of the top bar (hidden on narrow containers).

### ModAppShellActions — `[modAppShellActions]`

Marks the end actions of the top bar: language switch, notifications, user menu.

### ModAppShell — `mod-app-shell`

Application frame: a side bar with grouped navigation, a top bar and the scrolling main content area. Navigation comes from `groups`; an item is a link when it has an `href`, otherwise a button. Selecting an item sets `activeId` (marked with `aria-current="page"`) and emits `itemSelect`, so the application can navigate with its own router. Wide containers: the side bar is always visible and can be collapsed to an icon rail (`collapsed`). Under 900px of ITS OWN width (container query) the side bar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by the menu button of the top bar: modal, with a backdrop, focus kept inside, and closed by Escape, the backdrop, the close button or selecting an item. The shell is `--mod-app-shell-height` tall (default `100vh`); only the main area scrolls. The main area is a query container named `mod-app-content`, so page content can use `@container mod-app-content (max-width: …)`. `--mod-app-shell-side-width` (default 272px) sets the side bar width.

```html
<mod-app-shell [groups]="groups" [(activeId)]="page" [(collapsed)]="collapsed" (itemSelect)="go($event)">
  <img modAppShellLogo src="assets/logo.png" alt="Organization name" />
  <img modAppShellLogoMark src="assets/emblem.png" alt="Organization name" />
  <span modAppShellFooter>Version 1.4</span>
  <strong modAppShellTitle>Referral system</strong>
  <mod-search-box modAppShellSearch placeholder="Search" />
  <button modAppShellActions mod-button variant="subtle" iconOnly aria-label="Notifications">
    <mod-icon name="notification-03" />
  </button>
  …page content (rendered inside <main>)…
</mod-app-shell>
```

Content slots: `[modAppShellLogo]`, `[modAppShellLogoMark]`, `[modAppShellFooter]`, `[modAppShellTitle]`, `[modAppShellSearch]`, `[modAppShellActions]`, `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[groups]` | input | `readonly ModAppShellGroup[]` | `[]` | Side navigation, in groups. |
| `[(activeId)]` | model | `string` | `''` | Id of the current item (two-way bindable). |
| `[(collapsed)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Side bar collapsed to an icon rail on wide containers (two-way bindable). |
| `[collapsible]` | input | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the collapse / expand button of the side bar. |
| `[(drawerOpen)]` | model | `boolean` | `false` | Off-canvas drawer open on narrow containers (two-way bindable). |
| `[navLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Main navigation'` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. |
| `[collapseLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Collapse the side menu'` |  |
| `[expandLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Expand the side menu'` |  |
| `[openMenuLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Open the menu'` |  |
| `[closeMenuLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Close the menu'` |  |
| `[skipLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Skip to main content'` | Text of the skip link (first focusable element of the shell). |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModAppShellItem` |  | Emitted when an enabled item is chosen (after `activeId` was updated). |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModAppShellItem { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; badge?: string | number; badgeLabel?: string; href?: string; disabled?: boolean; }
interface ModAppShellGroup { id?: string; label?: string; items: readonly ModAppShellItem[]; }
```

## stat-card

### ModStatCard — `mod-stat-card`

KPI tile: a label, one large value, and optionally an icon, a unit, a trend against the previous period and a caption. The trend is announced in words: its direction is given by an arrow icon and by hidden text (`upLabel` / `downLabel` / `flatLabel`), never by colour alone. `tone` adds an accent bar for values that need attention. Default content is rendered under the caption (e.g. a link).

```html
<mod-stat-card
  label="Acceptance rate"
  value="78.4"
  unit="%"
  icon="checkmark-circle-02"
  trend="up"
  trendTone="positive"
  trendText="2.1 points higher than the previous period"
/>
<mod-stat-card label="Pending actions" [value]="7" tone="warning" caption="Open the pending actions" />
<mod-stat-card label="Total referrals" loading />
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[label]` | input, required | `string` |  | What the number measures. |
| `[value]` | input | `string \| number` | `''` | The value, already formatted. |
| `[unit]` | input | `string` | `''` | Unit shown after the value in smaller type (%, hours, days…). |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. |
| `[trend]` | input | `ModStatCardTrend \| ''` | `''` | Direction of the change against the previous period. Empty hides the trend line. |
| `[trendText]` | input | `string` | `''` | Text of the trend line, e.g. "12% higher than the previous period". |
| `[trendTone]` | input | `ModStatCardTrendTone` | `'neutral'` | Colours the trend as good or bad. |
| `[caption]` | input | `string` | `''` | Small helper line under the value. |
| `[tone]` | input | `ModStatCardTone` | `'default'` | Accent for values that need attention. |
| `[loading]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a skeleton instead of the value. |
| `[upLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Increase'` | Hidden text announced before the trend text. |
| `[downLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Decrease'` |  |
| `[flatLabel]` | input | `string` | `'No change'` |  |
| `[loadingLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Loading'` | Hidden text of the loading placeholder. The card is not a live region (a dashboard has many cards): announce the loading of the whole view once, in the page. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModStatCardTone = 'default' | 'positive' | 'warning' | 'critical'
type ModStatCardTrend = 'up' | 'down' | 'flat'
type ModStatCardTrendTone = 'neutral' | 'positive' | 'negative'
```

## bar-list

### ModBarList — `mod-bar-list`

Ranked list of labelled horizontal bars, for "top N" breakdowns. Bars are scaled to the largest value (or to `max`). The markup is a list (`ol` when `ranked`, otherwise `ul`); every row gives its value as text, so the bar itself is decorative. `format` turns a value into text; `unit` is appended to it. A label with `href` is a link and emits `itemSelect` on click.

```html
<mod-bar-list
  aria-label="Referrals by specialty"
  [items]="[
    { label: 'Cardiology', value: 212 },
    { label: 'Orthopedic Surgery', value: 164 },
  ]"
  unit="referrals"
  ranked
/>
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[items]` | input | `readonly ModBarListItem[]` | `[]` |  |
| `[max]` | input | `number \| null` | `null` | Value of a full bar. Defaults to the largest value in `items`. |
| `[format]` | input | `(value: number) => string` | `(value) => value.toLocaleString('en-US')` | Turns a value into its text. Defaults to the number grouped by thousands. |
| `[unit]` | input | `string` | `''` | Appended to every formatted value, e.g. "referrals" or "hours". |
| `[ranked]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Numbers the rows (an ordered list). |
| `[compact]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Tighter rows. |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `[emptyText]` | input | `string` | `'No data'` | Shown when `items` is empty. |
| `(itemSelect)` | output | `ModBarListItem` |  | Emitted when a linked label is activated. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModBarListTone = 'default' | 'neutral' | 'warning' | 'critical'
interface ModBarListItem { id?: string; label: string; value: number; text?: string; href?: string; tone?: ModBarListTone; }
```

## column-chart

### ModColumnChart — `mod-column-chart`

Simple column chart for one or two series, drawn with CSS (no chart library). Accessibility: the chart is a labelled group; every column can be focused with the keyboard and announces "category, series: value"; the value also appears in a tooltip on hover and focus; and the same data is available to assistive technology as a visually hidden table. With two series a legend is shown and the second series is hatched, so the series do not differ by colour alone. In RTL the categories run from right to left.

```html
<mod-column-chart
  aria-label="Referrals per month"
  [categories]="['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov']"
  [series]="[
    { name: 'Received', values: [182, 204, 197, 231, 248, 226] },
    { name: 'Accepted', values: [141, 160, 158, 176, 197, 171] },
  ]"
  unit="referrals"
/>
```

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[categories]` | input | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Category names along the horizontal axis. |
| `[series]` | input | `readonly ModColumnChartSeries[]` | `[]` | One or two series (further series are ignored). |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the chart (required for a meaningful chart). |
| `[max]` | input | `number \| null` | `null` | End of the value axis. Defaults to a rounded value above the largest data value. |
| `[tickCount]` | input | `number` | `4` | Number of intervals on the value axis. |
| `[format]` | input | `(value: number) => string` | `(value) => value.toLocaleString('en-US')` | Turns a value into its text. Defaults to the number grouped by thousands. |
| `[unit]` | input | `string` | `''` | Appended to values in tooltips, accessible names and the data table, e.g. "referrals". |
| `[height]` | input | `number` | `240` | Height of the plot area in pixels. |
| `[showValues]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Prints every value above its column. |
| `[legendLabel]` | input | `string` | `'Legend'` | Accessible name of the legend. |
| `[tableCaption]` | input | `string` | `''` | Caption of the hidden data table. Defaults to the chart's accessible name. |
| `[categoryHeader]` | input | `string` | `'Category'` | Header of the first column of the hidden data table. |
| `[valueHeader]` | input | `string` | `'Value'` | Header of the value column when a series has no name. |

Exported types:

```ts
interface ModColumnChartSeries { name: string; values: readonly number[]; }
```

## description-list

### ModDescriptionList — `mod-description-list`

Read-only details as label / value pairs. `columns` is the layout on wide containers; the list measures ITS OWN width and drops to two columns under 720px and one under 400px. It is exposed as a list of items, each read as "label, value".

```html
<mod-description-list columns="3" dividers aria-label="Patient details">
  <mod-description-item label="Patient" value="Fahad Al-Otaibi" />
  <mod-description-item label="File number" value="48213" />
  <mod-description-item label="Status">
    <mod-status-tag variant="warning">Medical review</mod-status-tag>
  </mod-description-item>
  <mod-description-item label="Diagnosis" span="full">Long text…</mod-description-item>
</mod-description-list>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[columns]` | input | `number` | `1 as ModDescriptionListColumns` | Number of columns on wide containers. |
| `[layout]` | input | `ModDescriptionListLayout` | `'stacked'` |  |
| `[dividers]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Line between the rows. |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the list. |

### ModDescriptionItem — `mod-description-item`

One label / value pair of a `<mod-description-list>`. The value is the `value` input, projected content, or both (content after the text).

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[label]` | input, required | `string` |  |  |
| `[value]` | input | `string \| number` | `''` | Plain text value. Use projected content for tags, links or formatted text. |
| `[span]` | input | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 'full'` | `1` | Columns the item covers; `full` takes the whole row. |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModDescriptionListColumns = 1 | 2 | 3
type ModDescriptionListLayout = 'stacked' | 'inline'
```

## timeline

### ModTimeline — `mod-timeline`

Vertical activity timeline: what happened, when and by whom, newest or oldest first as the items are given. The timeline is exposed as a list. Each item shows a marker (a dot, or the item's `icon`) joined to the next one by a line.

```html
<mod-timeline aria-label="Referral history">
  <mod-timeline-item heading="Referral accepted" time="Today, 09:40" actor="Head of Cardiology" tone="success" icon="checkmark-circle-02">
    Accepted for the outpatient clinic.
  </mod-timeline-item>
  <mod-timeline-item heading="Eligibility checked" time="Yesterday, 14:05" actor="Medical coordinator" />
</mod-timeline>
```

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[compact]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Tighter spacing and smaller markers. |
| `[aria-label]` | input | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the list. |

### ModTimelineItem — `mod-timeline-item`

One event of a `<mod-timeline>`. Projected content is the body under the title line (a note, a tag, a link).

Content slots: `(default)`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[heading]` | input, required | `string` |  | What happened. |
| `[time]` | input | `string` | `''` | When, already formatted ("Today, 09:40", "2 hours ago"). |
| `[actor]` | input | `string` | `''` | Who did it (a name or a role). |
| `[tone]` | input | `ModTimelineTone` | `'default'` | Colour of the marker. |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix, shown in the marker. Empty shows a dot. |
| `[toneLabel]` | input | `string` | `''` | Hidden text announced before the heading when the tone carries meaning, e.g. "Rejected". |

Exported types:

```ts
type ModTimelineTone = 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info'
```

## empty-state

### ModEmptyStateActions — `[modEmptyStateActions]`

Marks the actions (buttons, links) of a `<mod-empty-state>`.

### ModEmptyState — `mod-empty-state`

Placeholder for a list, table or panel that has nothing to show. `compact` is for small panels and table bodies: smaller icon and spacing. `bordered` draws a dashed frame for an empty drop area or page section. Default content is rendered between the text and the actions.

```html
<mod-empty-state
  icon="inbox"
  heading="No pending actions"
  text="No case is waiting for an action of your role now."
>
  <button modEmptyStateActions mod-button size="medium">New referral request</button>
</mod-empty-state>
<mod-empty-state compact heading="No data" text="Try a longer period." />
```

Content slots: `(default)`, `[modEmptyStateActions]`.

| Binding | Kind | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[heading]` | input, required | `string` |  | Short statement of what is empty. |
| `[text]` | input | `string` | `''` | One or two sentences: why, and what to do next. |
| `[icon]` | input | `string` | `''` | Icon name without the `dga-icon-` prefix. |
| `[level]` | input | `0 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title (2, 3 or 4). 0 renders a paragraph, for use inside a table cell. |
| `[compact]` | input | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `[bordered]` | input | `boolean` | `false` | Dashed frame around the block. |
